lore:
Akhelian Tide Guard

An Akhelian King or Queen never rides to war alone. Their Tide Guard — finest Morrsarr shock riders, Ishlaen bodyguards, and Namarti Reaver scouts — put beast and body between any blow meant for their liege.

Surge and Shield

Morrsarr Guard crash in with biovoltaic voltspears while Ishlaen Guard hold the line with galv-shields. Namarti Reavers harry the foe with whisperbow fire.

Spearhead Force

In the third battle round, Royal Imperative turns honour into a decisive strike — Strike-first fury or Crit (Mortal) precision.

armyRules.name: ROYAL IMPERATIVE
armyRules.description: Desperate to honour their liege, the Tide Guard strike a decisive blow. You can only use this ability in the third battle round. Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle round: Into Them!: Friendly units have Strike-first. Strike Sure: Friendly units’ melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

regimentAbilities.name: THE SPEAR OF ASPHOREN
regimentAbilities.description: Those Idoneth who wish to follow the example of legendary commander Asphoren must strike at the foe like the surging tide. Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability. Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for that unit for the rest of the turn.

effects.description: +1 to charge rolls for the rest of the turn

regimentAbilities.name: THE SHIELD OF ULCHISS
regimentAbilities.description: Mastery of the ebb and flow of battle is core to the teachings of Ulchiss, which state that a timely withdrawal can open up enemy vulnerabilities. Declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability. Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time that unit uses a Retreat ability, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.

effects.description: Retreat abilities inflict no mortal damage on this unit for the rest of the turn

enhancements.name: DUTIFUL SOULS
enhancements.description: The Tide Guard will fight to protect their King even when gravely wounded. Declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target. Effect: You can return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target is an Infantry unit, you can return D3 slain models to it instead.

enhancements.name: SHIMMERING AMULET
enhancements.description: This void-pearl amulet conceals its wearer behind a shimmering cloak of refracted magic. Effect: Your general has Ward (5+).

enhancements.name: VOLTAIC CHARGE
enhancements.description: This general’s weapons crackle with electric power, ready to be discharged. Effect: Your general’s Akhelian Royal Weapons have Charge (+1 Damage).

ability.name: Charge (+1 Damage)
ability.description: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of Akhelian Royal Weapons if this unit charged in the same turn.

enhancements.name: SOUL STEALER
enhancements.description: This warrior is said to siphon the spirits of fallen foes to sustain them in battle. Effect: If your general is in combat, Heal (D3) your general.

meleeWeapons.name: Deepmare’s Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities.name: Companion
abilities.description: Unless otherwise specified, attacks made by this weapon cannot get an improvement to their hit, wound or weapon characteristics.

abilities.name: RAIDERS’ RESOLVE
abilities.description: The Akhelian King orders the warriors under their command to stand firm in the face of the enemy. Declare: Pick another friendly unit wholly within this unit’s combat range to be the target. Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: WAVE RIDER
abilities.description: When an Akhelian King charges the foe, they hit with the power of a crashing wave. Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target. Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Charge (+1 Damage)
abilities.description: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this weapon if this unit charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Companion
abilities.description: Unless otherwise specified, attacks made by this weapon cannot get an improvement to their hit, wound or weapon characteristics.

abilities.name: BIOVOLTAIC BLAST
abilities.description: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is stored by Morrsarr Guard, ready to be discharged as a bolt of energy when the time is right. Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target. Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Companion
abilities.description: Unless otherwise specified, attacks made by this weapon cannot get an improvement to their hit, wound or weapon characteristics.

abilities.name: BIOVOLTAIC BARRIER
abilities.description: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is channelled by Ishlaen Guard into a crackling luminescent energy field that protects them from harm. Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: STRIKE ON THE MOVE
abilities.description: Namarti Reavers are experts at running out from cover to unleash a hail of deadly arrows. Effect: This unit can use Shoot abilities even if it used a Run or Retreat ability in the same turn.
